package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const productTestStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func TestProductAwarePromptPolicyV2KeepsV1ReplayImmutable(t *testing.T) {
	_, legacyUI, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepExperience, "ru", 2)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, productUI, err := BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepExperience, "ru", 2)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, string(legacyUI), `"id":"experience.new"`)
	require.NotContains(t, string(legacyUI), "experience.beginner")
	require.Contains(t, string(productUI), `"id":"experience.beginner"`)
	require.NotContains(t, string(productUI), "experience.new")
	require.Contains(t, string(productUI), `.v2`)
	policy, err := TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion(legacyUI)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1, policy)
	policy, err = TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion(productUI)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2, policy)
}

func TestProductAwarePolicyUsesExactGoalUndecidedAndDeferredFields(t *testing.T) {
	_, goalUI, err := BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepGoal, "ru", 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, string(goalUI), `"id":"goal.learn_programming"`)
	require.Contains(t, string(goalUI), "learn_programming")
	_, directionUI, err := BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepDirection, "ru", 1)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, string(directionUI), `"id":"direction.undecided"`)
	require.Contains(t, string(directionUI), "Не знаю")
	for _, deferred := range []TeacherOnboardingStep{OnboardingStepKnownStack, OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes, OnboardingStepPace} {
		_, _, err = BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(deferred, "ru", 1)
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
	}
}

func TestProductAwarePlanCoversFoundationGoAndMissingCoreFields(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name       string
		reason     string
		result     string
		goal       *TeacherLearningReadinessGoal
		mutate     func(*TeacherStudentOnboardingState)
		wantStatus TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status
		wantStep   TeacherOnboardingStep
		wantText   string
	}{
		{name: "intent", result: TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, wantStep: OnboardingStepGoal},
		{name: "experience", result: TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete, mutate: func(state *TeacherStudentOnboardingState) { goal := "learn_programming"; state.Draft.GoalCode = &goal }, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, wantStep: OnboardingStepExperience},
		{name: "direction", result: TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete, mutate: func(state *TeacherStudentOnboardingState) {
			goal, experience := "learn_programming", "beginner"
			state.Draft.GoalCode, state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience = &goal, &experience
		}, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, wantStep: OnboardingStepDirection},
		{name: "language", result: TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonContentLanguageUntrusted, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, wantStep: OnboardingStepLanguage},
		{name: "stack", result: TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved, mutate: func(state *TeacherStudentOnboardingState) {
			direction := "backend"
			state.Draft.DirectionCode = &direction
		}, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, wantStep: OnboardingStepDesiredStack},
		{name: "backend contradiction corrects stack", result: TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonProfileContradictory, mutate: func(state *TeacherStudentOnboardingState) {
			direction := "backend"
			state.Draft.DirectionCode = &direction
		}, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, wantStep: OnboardingStepDesiredStack},
		{name: "undecided contradiction corrects direction", result: TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonProfileContradictory, mutate: func(state *TeacherStudentOnboardingState) {
			direction := "undecided"
			desired := []string{"go"}
			state.Draft.DirectionCode, state.Draft.DesiredStacks = &direction, &desired
		}, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, wantStep: OnboardingStepDirection},
		{name: "foundation", result: TeacherLearningReadinessReady, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved, goal: &TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, wantText: TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName},
		{name: "go", result: TeacherLearningReadinessReady, reason: TeacherReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved, goal: &TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: TeacherGoBackendGoalCode, Version: TeacherGoBackendGoalVersion, GraphVersion: TeacherGoBackendGraphVersion}, wantStatus: TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, wantText: TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName},
	}
	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			state := productDraftState(4)
			if testCase.mutate != nil {
				testCase.mutate(&state)
			}
			readiness := validProductReadiness(testCase.result, testCase.reason, testCase.goal, 4)
			plan, err := BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(readiness, state, productTestStudentID, "ru")
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, testCase.wantStatus, plan.Status)
			require.Equal(t, testCase.wantStep, plan.Step)
			if testCase.wantText != "" {
				require.Contains(t, plan.Body, testCase.wantText)
				require.Contains(t, plan.Body, "ещё не созданы")
				require.Empty(t, plan.AssistantUI)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestProductAwareUndecidedReadyNeverAsksStackWeeklyOrPace(t *testing.T) {
	state := productDraftState(4)
	goal, experience, direction, language := "learn_programming", "beginner", "undecided", "ru"
	state.Draft.GoalCode, state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience, state.Draft.DirectionCode, state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &goal, &experience, &direction, &language
	readiness := validProductReadiness(TeacherLearningReadinessReady, TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved, &TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}, 4)
	plan, err := BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(readiness, state, productTestStudentID, "ru")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, plan.Status)
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"стек", "недел", "темп"} {
		require.NotContains(t, plan.Body, forbidden)
	}
	inconsistent := validProductReadiness(TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification, TeacherReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved, nil, 4)
	_, err = BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(inconsistent, state, productTestStudentID, "ru")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable, "undecided must never be redirected into a stack prompt")
}

func TestProductAwareActivePathAndUnsupportedNeverExposeRawIdentifiersOrFakeMutation(t *testing.T) {
	state := productDraftState(4)
	active := validProductReadiness(TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady, TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists, nil, 4)
	active.ActivePath = &TeacherLearningReadinessActivePath{LearningPathID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Version: 3, CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "learn_programming", Status: "ACTIVE"}
	plan, err := BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(active, state, productTestStudentID, "ru")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingSessionActivePathExists, plan.Status)
	require.Empty(t, plan.AssistantUI)
	require.NotContains(t, plan.Body, active.ActivePath.LearningPathID)
	require.NotContains(t, plan.Body, active.ActivePath.CourseID)

	unsupported := validProductReadiness(TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady, TeacherReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported, nil, 4)
	plan, err = BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(unsupported, state, productTestStudentID, "ru")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting, plan.Status)
	require.Equal(t, OnboardingStepDirection, plan.Step)
	require.Contains(t, plan.Body, "пока не поддерживается")
	require.NotContains(t, plan.Body, TeacherReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported)
	require.NotEmpty(t, plan.AssistantUI)
}

func TestProductAwareSemanticAcceptsMultipleLowRiskFactsAtomically(t *testing.T) {
	state := productDraftState(0)
	interaction := TeacherOnboardingInteraction{SlotCode: TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, ExpectedDraftVersion: 0, ExpectedProfileVersion: 0}
	result, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "ok",
		SlotCandidates: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{
			{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, CodeValue: "learn_programming", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9800},
			{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, CodeValue: "beginner", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9700},
			{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage, CodeValue: "ru", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9600},
		}, Questions: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	decision, err := NewProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(result, interaction, state)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation, decision.Kind)
	require.Len(t, decision.Candidates, 3)
	require.Nil(t, decision.Candidate)
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingSessionV2TerminalOmitsPromptAndRawPlannerData(t *testing.T) {
	session, err := ProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSession(TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Schema, DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		Status: TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, Phase: TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart,
		StateRef: TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		Terminal: &TeacherOnboardingTerminal{Kind: TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, DisplayName: TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(session)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), "current_prompt")
	require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), "reason")
	require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), "graph")
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingSessionV3PathOutcomeMarkerIsStrictAndTerminalOnly(t *testing.T) {
	valid := TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{
		Kind: TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind, Status: TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerReady,
		DialogMessageID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
	}
	marker, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker(valid)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, valid, marker)

	for _, invalid := range []TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{
		{Kind: "onboarding_path_outcome", Status: TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerReady, DialogMessageID: valid.DialogMessageID},
		{Kind: TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind, Status: TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerStatus(TeacherOnboardingPathStateChanged), DialogMessageID: valid.DialogMessageID},
		{Kind: TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind, Status: TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerReady, DialogMessageID: "not-a-uuid"},
	} {
		_, err = NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker(invalid)
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
	}

	_, err = DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema, DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Status: TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting, Phase: TeacherOnboardingPhaseGettingAcquainted,
		StateRef:      TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		CurrentPrompt: &TeacherOnboardingCurrentPrompt{MessageID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", MessageVersion: 1},
		PathOutcome:   &valid,
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
}

func TestProductAwareDeliveryDispositionSeparatesTerminalFromTangentAfterRestart(t *testing.T) {
	turn := TeacherOnboardingTurn{InteractionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentEffectState: TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted}
	disposition, err := ProductAwareOnboardingDeliveryDisposition(turn, false)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingDeliveryCloseTerminal, disposition)

	turn.StudentEffectState = TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted
	disposition, err = ProductAwareOnboardingDeliveryDisposition(turn, false)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingDeliveryPreserve, disposition)

	turn.StudentEffectState = TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted
	disposition, err = ProductAwareOnboardingDeliveryDisposition(turn, true)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingDeliveryReplace, disposition)
}

func TestClosedOnboardingInteractionRequiresHonestTerminalEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 18, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	interaction := TeacherOnboardingInteraction{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PersonalTeacherID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PromptMessageID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", PromptMessageVersion: 1,
		PromptAssistantUIDigest: strings.Repeat("a", 64), SlotCode: TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection,
		SessionSchemaVersion: 3,
		State:                TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosed, ClosedReason: TeacherOnboardingClosedPlanningReady, ClosedAt: now, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	_, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction.ClosedReason = ""
	_, err = NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(interaction)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
}

func productDraftState(version int64) TeacherStudentOnboardingState {
	state := TeacherStudentOnboardingState{Schema: TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema, ProfileVersion: 0, Draft: StudentOnboardingDraft{Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: productTestStudentID, Status: StudentOnboardingDraftDraft, Version: version}}
	if version > 0 {
		now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
		state.Draft.CreatedAt, state.Draft.UpdatedAt = &now, &now
	}
	return state
}

func validProductReadiness(result, reason string, goal *TeacherLearningReadinessGoal, version int64) TeacherLearningReadiness {
	return TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: result, ReasonCodes: []string{reason}, ResolverVersion: TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: version}, ReadinessScope: TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
		Executable: false, ContentStatus: TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: goal}
}
